title: Place
description: A place returned by the Google Places API, such as an establishment or point of interest.

name.description: The resource name of the place, in the form places/{placeId}.

id.description: The unique identifier of the place.

types.description: A set of type tags describing this place.

primaryType.description: The primary type of the given result.

formattedAddress.description: A full, human-readable address for this place.
formattedAddress.example: 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA

shortFormattedAddress.description: A short, human-readable address for this place.
shortFormattedAddress.example: 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA

rating.description: The average user rating for this place, from 1.0 to 5.0.

userRatingCount.description: The total number of user reviews and ratings for this place.

priceLevel.description: The price level of the place.

businessStatus.description: The operational status of the business at this location.

nationalPhoneNumber.description: A human-readable phone number in national format.

internationalPhoneNumber.description: A human-readable phone number in international format.

websiteUri.description: The authoritative website for this place.

googleMapsUri.description: A URI providing a link to this place on Google Maps.
